intro.text: A young groom in the service of King Elhokar.

items.text: Questioned by Sadeas about the king's broken girth strap, Fin said he had put the king's favourite saddle on the horse himself, but that it had been changed before the head grooms took the horse to the Kholin camp. A nervous Fin repeated this at one of the king's feasts, testimony that helped clear Dalinar.

appearance.text: About twelve, darkeyed, with sandy hair flecked with black.
